canvas-white.$description: Canvas White — Primary page background, card surfaces, input fills

cloud-mist.$description: Cloud Mist — Alternate section background, subtle surface tier below white

frost-tint.$description: Frost Tint — Tertiary surface, muted background blocks

ash-border.$description: Ash Border — Hairline dividers, card borders, table separators

mist-border.$description: Mist Border — Secondary borders, disabled state outlines

fog-text.$description: Fog Text — Helper text, link underlines in body copy, placeholder text

steel-text.$description: Steel Text — Muted metadata, timestamps, caption text

slate-body.$description: Slate Body — Secondary body text, descriptions, supporting paragraphs

graphite-heading.$description: Graphite Heading — Primary headings, strong body text, high-emphasis content

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Dark surface fills, announcement bar, code terminal background, primary button background

onyx.$description: Onyx — Deepest text, high-contrast dark surfaces

volt-violet.$description: Volt Violet — Primary CTA fill, active link, brand accent — vivid violet against slate neutrals is the single chromatic punctuation of the entire system

lavender-wash.$description: Lavender Wash — Muted accent background, hero pixel-art mid-tones, tag chips

lilac-whisper.$description: Lilac Whisper — Tertiary accent surface, selected row tint, soft callout

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

britti-sans-trial-semibold.$description: Display headlines and hero copy. The aggressive -0.025em tracking at 76px and condensed 0.95 line-height make text feel architectural and code-like. Substitute: Space Grotesk Bold or General Sans Semibold.

britti-sans-medium.$description: Section headings (H2/H3), nav items, emphasized UI labels. Carries brand personality into subhead levels. Substitute: Space Grotesk Medium.

inter.$description: Body copy, paragraphs, descriptions. The slight negative tracking (-0.01 to -0.02em) keeps even long-form text dense but readable. Substitute: Inter is already Google-hosted.

inter-variable.$description: UI controls, buttons, badges, form labels, nav links — the workhorse for interactive elements.

ibm-plex-mono.$description: Code snippets, terminal output, inline `<code>` elements. Signals the developer-first audience.

britti-sans-trial-regular.$description: Britti Sans Trial Regular — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

micro-5.$description: Micro 5 — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
